song.title: Are You Gonna Be My Girl

guitar.notes: Australian garage rock band; guitarists use typical rock guitars but nothing singularly iconic documented.

tone.target: bright chunky garage-rock crunch with open upper mids
tone.profile: bright chunky garage-rock crunch with open upper mids
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Boost for initial punch, followed by a Distortion pedal for core grit, feeding into a UK 45 or UK 50 amp model with a Marshall-style cabinet and minimal reverb for aggressive clarity.

rig.name: Jet - Are You Gonna Be My Girl - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and sustain buzz inherent in aggressive rhythm playing.
Provide initial punch and tighten the attack for palm-muted chugging.
blocks.gap: The Boost pedal is used here to simulate a clean boost/overdrive effect without adding mud, focusing on transient response.

alternatives.reason: If more grit than pure punch is desired.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core raw rhythm crunch and edge-of-breakup required for garage rock.
blocks.gap: The general 'Distortion' model is chosen to emulate a classic Plexi/Marshall grit, avoiding modern metal tones or excessive fuzz.

alternatives.reason: If the tone needs slightly more vintage warmth.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British 'Plexi' crunch tone and open upper mids.
Simulate the classic Marshall-style cabinet and provide necessary mid-range punch.
Fine-tune the tone by boosting upper mids and trebles for maximum bite and clarity.
Optional subtle thickening for verses (kept off for aggressive rhythm).
blocks.gap: Chorus is generally avoided, but a very subtle setting can add dimension without sounding '80s'. It's kept inactive by default.

blocks.purpose: Add a touch of natural room ambience without muddying the aggressive rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: The reverb is kept low and short to maintain dryness, fulfilling the 'keep it dry' requirement while adding depth.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more controlled decay is preferred.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to enhance upper mids and attack, crucial for bright garage-rock clarity.

proposals.reason: Enhance the 'bright attack' and open upper mids required for garage rock bite.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in chords/riffs.
